scalars.scalar_value: EXPERIENCE: Four years of experience related to the duties of the position.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the minimum qualifications for the Administrative Assistant III position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Experience Requirement: One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units. Experience and education used to meet the minimum qualifications must be clearly stated in the application. Options: I have four (4) or more years of experience related to the duties of the position. | I have three (3) years of experience related to the duties of the position PLUS one (1) year (30 smester/45 quarter units) of college-level coursework from an accredited institution. | I have two (2) years of experience related to the duties of the position PLUS two (2) years (60 smester/90 quarter units) of college-level course work from an accredited institution. | I have LESS THAN two (2) years of experience related to the duties of the position.
EXPERIENCE: Four years of experience related to the duties of the position.
EDUCATION: Two years of college level business, office technology, or related course work from an accredited institution may be substituted for up to two years of the required experience.

Promotional : Two years of experience with Los Rios Community College District performing duties equivalent to the level of Administrative Assistant. (Promotional applies to current, regular Classified employees working with the Los Rios Community College District.)

( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.)
Education must be from an accredited institution.

Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment.
